title: Llama Llama Back To School
author: Anna Dewdney, Reed Duncan
book_summary: As summer ends, Llama Llama isn't ready to give up backyard camping, picnics, and ice cream with friends, and he feels anxious about his first day back at school. Mama Llama takes him shopping for school supplies, and once the first day arrives Llama Llama learns the classroom rules (stand in line, raise your hand, coats on hooks) alongside his seasoned classmates. When a new young rhino student arrives feeling scared, Llama Llama shares his crayons and shows him how to use glue, helping the newcomer become part of the group.
